behavior: Fixed enable/bypass commands over existing private native channel and authenticated HTTP; no arbitrary environment, executable, frequency, gain or RF command.
Only bound-GUI idle state with fresh local IQ and no armed/running source is eligible. Changed selection invalidates fit; duplicate nonce cannot repeat a change or extend a source.
PDTALK05 advertises correction selection; older sessions refuse it without dispatch. Native correction_control capability is required.
Selection serializes with source arms. Uncertain native reply or credential revocation retires the owned DSP lifetime.
Desktop invalidates old capture preparation on request, treats ACK as receipt, reads status, and never keys or rearms automatically. Stop preempts selection.
Selection belongs to one DSP session; new-session correction-enabled default unchanged.
